title: Right route on a pinned tensor summand
statement: Fix schemes $X,X',S,S'$, morphisms $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$, and a cartesian square $sq:\operatorname{IsPullback}(g',f',f,g)$. Assume the derived-category instances of the module-sheaf categories. Let $P,Q$ be arbitrary integer cochain complexes of module sheaves on $X$, $N$ such a complex on $X'$, $H_0=\operatorname{tensorPullback}(g')$ the module pullback functor, $H$ its degreewise extension, and $a:HQ\to N$ a chain map. At $z\in X'$ put $R=\mathcal O_{S,f(g'z)}$, $A=\mathcal O_{X,g'z}$, $B=\mathcal O_{S',f'z}$, $C=\mathcal O_{X',z}$, with the algebra maps induced by the square [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let $b:A\to A\otimes_R B\to C$ be the resulting composite ring map, $G=\operatorname{extendScalars}(b)$, $F=G$ applied degreewise, $T$ the stalk functor at $g'z$ on $X$, $S$ the stalk functor at $z$ on $X'$ applied degreewise, $U=T(P)$ and $V=T(Q)$. Write $\kappa_L=\operatorname{tensorStalkIso}(f,f',g,g',sq,z,L):F(TL)\cong S(HL)$ for the specified pullback-stalk comparison. Let $e_{L,M}:T\operatorname{Tot}(L\otimes M)\cong TL\otimes TM$ and $e'_{L,M}:S\operatorname{Tot}(L\otimes M)\cong SL\otimes SM$ be the chosen pinned stalk tensor comparisons [lem-pc-tensor-pullback-stalk-square], characterized on each summand by the canonical module tensor-stalk comparison. Define $t=\kappa_Q;S(a)$ and $\rho=(\kappa_P\otimes1_{SN});(e'_{HP,N})^{-1}$. For integers $n,p,q$ with $p+q=n$, let $j=G(\iota_{U,V}^{p,q,n})$. Then $j;(\mu_F^{-1};(1\otimes t);\rho)_n=\delta_G(U^p,V^q);(\kappa_{P,p}\otimes\kappa_{Q,q});(1\otimes S(a)_q);\iota_{SHP,SN}^{p,q,n};(e'_{HP,N})^{-1}_n$.

source.place: Tag 0DJA(1), local tensor comparison calculation using Tag 0BYJ

proof.text: Expand the complex tensorator as the oplax total-complex comparison. Its summand formula is δ_G followed by the summand injection. Apply the whiskerLeft summand formula and the mapBifunctorMap summand formula to κ_P tensor identity. Expand the module tensor hom, distribute whiskerLeft over composition, commute the two whiskerings using whisker_exchange twice, and cancel identity whiskerings. The result is exactly the displayed explicit map.
